description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Zell], [My Final Heaven Ability Tracker] and [My Final Heaven Level]

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Zell
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of My Final Heaven (0~2), removed after using My Final Heaven two times

description.name: My Final Heaven Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases My Final Heaven level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Fire abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Zell]

description.name: My Final Heaven Level
description.text: Keeps track of My Final Heaven level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Zell]
